vibeMeta.behavior: A Canvas 2D atmospheric sky: a vertical multi-stop gradient horizon built from three palettes (day: bright blue with faint stars; dusk: violet + orange with a low warm sun; night: deep navy with a bright moon), a warm sun or pale moon rendered from a cached 560x560 offscreen radial-gradient sprite (hot white core + outer falloff haze), a seeded field of 130 twinkling stars concentrated toward the zenith (pow(rng,1.3)*0.85 high-altitude distribution; twinkle = 0.35 + 0.65 * max(0, sin(time * twinkleSpeed * 0.4 * speed + phase)) cosine curve with halo for bright stars), and soft cumulus clouds pre-baked into offscreen 480x220 puff sprites (8-12 overlapping radial-gradient blobs tinted per palette) that drift at dt * speed * (cloudSpeed*2.5 + 6), self-wrap at width + w, and draw a mirrored edge copy when overflowing. Pointer parallax uses a normalized target clamped to [-1,1] with exponential lerp (1 - exp(-4*dt)) across layers: stars 0.2x, orb 0.45x, clouds (0.5 + depth * 0.7)x. DPR capped at 2 (1.5 on canvases >1920px) with setTransform reset on ResizeObserver, cloud x positions re-homed if they pass width*1.5, IntersectionObserver parks the rAF loop off-screen, and prefers-reduced-motion cancels the loop, zeroes parallax and draws one static frame. The decorative canvas is pointer-events none and carries an aria-label describing the active palette.

vibeMeta.behavior: A raw-WebGL typographic wordmark (single GL context, one fullscreen-triangle draw, live state via refs). The text is rasterized once into an offscreen font atlas: a red fill plus a dashed green perimeter stroke laid into a black RGBA canvas, scaled to fit the 4096px texture cap with a 0.12em pad, then uploaded as a texture with mipmaps (POT or WebGL2) and re-baked whenever text/font/dpr/size changes. The fragment shader samples the atlas with a 6-direction blur to soften the stem, mixes sharp and soft reads by a pointer-distance falloff (k = 1 - smoothstep(0, reach, d)^3) so the wordmark sharpens under the cursor, blends a bottom-up shade gradient into the text color, and overlays an accent dashed triangle plus three dashed bounding boxes (uV0/uV1/uV2 + uHalf) around three drifting vertices. Pointer-aware motion: without a pointer the framerate viewport sweeps left-to-right at speed with constant y at the text baseline and a tiny z-noise sway; on pointermove the target snaps to the nearest cell centers around the cursor inside a 0.6-aspect grid, two vertices hitch cells while the third holds the pointer cell, and every vertex orbits its cell with per-cell pseudo-random sine drift (frequency 1.3 / 1.69) offset by a hash of the cell coords. Easing is an exponential damp (damping/100 * 20 * dt) toward the target. The host keeps a minWidth of 1200 and minHeight of 800, canvas DPR-capped at 2, rAF loop gated on document.visibilitychange, and the active hover reach/framing readouts are drawn as monospace labels at each handle.

vibeMeta.behavior: A raw-WebGL (three.js) scene of a fractured volcanic husk with a single fixed-timestep physics update (PHYS_STEP 1/120 with up to 5 substeps and 0.88 damping) integrated into the render loop. On mount the cracked rock shell (HULL_PLANES polyhedral shards clipped with CLIP_EPS) scatters and tumbles in via per-shard staggered entrance forces (scatter/tumble/stagger); as the shell opens, a molten core shines through with an animated flow noise (ROCK frag + LIGHT_GLSL + NOISE_GLSL) tinted by intensity and hotColor. The scene is dressed with orbiting marker crosses (CROSS_ARM geometry, WAIST/BEVEL), a free-floating debris field, and hot bead orbs. Pointer response maps pointer reach/strength into a repel force on the shell shards that springs back via settle; idle drift adds spin, bob and sway. A glow pass renders the core through down/up-sampled render targets (PREFILTER/DOWN/UP/COMPOSITE) with strength, radius and threshold, and the frame buffer is DPR-capped per quality tier. The whole loop is gated on visibility and the canvas resizes with its host.

vibeMeta.behavior: A Canvas 2D particle loader. Dots are seeded once on a fibonacci sphere (fib) and converted to polar coords; each frame a bump curve eases them from the equator shell up over the poles, then each dot is yaw/pitch-spun, perspective-projected (PERSPECTIVE 3.5 onto pv/(pv-z)) and painter-sorted by depth so nearer dots draw last. A cached autoFit probes 20 frames to scale the field into its host, and dotScaleFor sizes points by canvas size. Pointer drag reorients the shell with exponential-inertia damping (drag/damping), touchAction none enables one-finger fling on mobile. The canvas DPR-caps at 2 and re-measures the host every frame, so it resizes live without a ResizeObserver. Wrapper is 100%x100% with a 24px floor.

vibeMeta.behavior: Two mirrored conic-gradient arc groups (A at lap 0, B at lap 0.5) are masked to the border region via content-box/border-box xor mask, then animated along the element perimeter. Each frame builds a conic gradient from samples of the arc: withAlpha converts the color to rgba so stops can fade the tail, and the perimeter helper maps a 0-1 lap position to an angle on the box border so the arc wraps corners. The layout runs in a single rAF loop, reading live props via a ref (speed/movement/borderSize/color), and only writes the --arc custom property when speed > 0. Glow is three blurred plus-lighter layers at increasing blur/reach when glow > 0. A ResizeObserver tracks the host box so the arc geometry matches the real border; the root is 100%x100% flexShrink-0 and rounded to the requested radius.
